relationships.subject: vincamine
relationships.evidence_quote: We previously have reported that vincamine (Vin), a monoterpenoid indole alkaloid extracted from Madagascar periwinkle, is a GPR40 agonist.

relationships.subject: vincamine
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, Vin suppressed NLRP3 inflammasome activation through either β-Arrestin2 or β-Arrestin2/IκBα/NF-κB signaling

relationships.subject: vincamine
relationships.evidence_quote: alleviated oxidative stress through Nrf2 signaling in the sciatic nerve tissues of DPN mice and LPS/ATP-treated RSC96 cells

key_findings: Vincamine ameliorated diabetic peripheral neuropathy in STZ and db/db mice without lowering blood glucose.
Beneficial effects including NLRP3 suppression were abolished by GPR40 knockdown.
